panels.description: Inventory metadata and the latest stored TCP probe for the selected server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.target_name AS "Hostname",
  t.host AS "IP Address",
  t.port AS "Port",
  t.db_type AS "DB Type",
  t.environment AS "Environment",
  CASE
    WHEN latest.checked_at IS NULL OR latest.checked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes' THEN 'STALE'
    WHEN latest.is_up = 1 THEN 'UP'
    ELSE 'DOWN'
  END AS "Current Status"
FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_targets t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.checked_at, r.is_up
  FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_probe_results r
  WHERE r.target_name = t.target_name
  ORDER BY r.checked_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) latest ON true
WHERE t.target_name = ${server:sqlstring};

panels.title: TOTAL PROBES
panels.description: Observed 5-minute probes in the selected month or Grafana time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeFrom()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN '-infinity'::date
      ELSE to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    END AS from_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeTo()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN 'infinity'::date
      ELSE (to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
    END AS to_date
)
SELECT
  coalesce(sum(d.probes), 0)::bigint AS value,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(d.probes), 0) > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS progress,
  CASE
    WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN 'seluruh history - interval 5 menit'
    WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN greatest(ceil(extract(epoch FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 86400.0)::integer, 1)::text || ' hari - interval 5 menit'
    ELSE extract(day FROM (to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer::text || ' hari - interval 5 menit'
  END AS subtitle
FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_daily_kpi d
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE d.target_name = ${server:sqlstring}
  AND d.period_start BETWEEN b.from_date AND b.to_date;

panels.title: TOTAL DOWNTIME
panels.description: Failed samples multiplied by the 5-minute collection interval. Missing samples are not counted as downtime.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeFrom()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN '-infinity'::date
      ELSE to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    END AS from_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeTo()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN 'infinity'::date
      ELSE (to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
    END AS to_date
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    coalesce(sum(d.down_probes), 0)::bigint AS failed_probes,
    coalesce(sum(d.probes), 0)::bigint AS probes
  FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_daily_kpi d
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE d.target_name = ${server:sqlstring}
    AND d.period_start BETWEEN b.from_date AND b.to_date
), duration AS (
  SELECT failed_probes, probes, failed_probes * 5 AS failed_minutes
  FROM totals
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN failed_minutes = 0 THEN '0m'
    WHEN failed_minutes >= 1440 THEN
      (failed_minutes / 1440)::text || 'd ' || ((failed_minutes % 1440) / 60)::text || 'h' ||
      CASE WHEN failed_minutes % 60 > 0 THEN ' ' || (failed_minutes % 60)::text || 'm' ELSE '' END
    WHEN failed_minutes >= 60 THEN
      (failed_minutes / 60)::text || 'h' ||
      CASE WHEN failed_minutes % 60 > 0 THEN ' ' || (failed_minutes % 60)::text || 'm' ELSE '' END
    ELSE failed_minutes::text || 'm'
  END AS value,
  coalesce(round(failed_probes::numeric / nullif(probes, 0) * 100, 2), 0)::double precision AS progress,
  failed_probes::text || ' failed samples - interval 5 menit' AS subtitle
FROM duration;

WITH bounds AS (

    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeFrom()::date

)

panels.title: PROBE SUMMARY - PER DAY | ${month:text}
panels.description: Daily 5-minute probe totals for the selected server and period. Coverage distinguishes complete, partial, and missing days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requested_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeFrom()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN NULL::date
      ELSE to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    END AS from_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeTo()::date
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN NULL::date
      ELSE (to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
    END AS to_date
),
target_bounds AS (
  SELECT min(period_start) AS first_date, max(period_start) AS last_date
  FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_daily_kpi
  WHERE target_name = ${server:sqlstring}
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN t.first_date ELSE r.from_date END AS from_date,
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN t.last_date
      ELSE least(r.to_date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date)
    END AS to_date
  FROM requested_bounds r
  CROSS JOIN target_bounds t
),
days AS (
  SELECT day::date AS period_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(b.from_date, b.to_date, interval '1 day') AS day
  WHERE b.from_date IS NOT NULL
    AND b.to_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  to_char(day.period_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00') AS "Start Probe",
  CASE
    WHEN d.period_start IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
    WHEN d.probes < 288 THEN 'PARTIAL'
    ELSE 'FULL'
  END AS "Coverage",
  d.up_probes AS "Number of Success",
  d.down_probes AS "Number of Failed",
  CASE WHEN d.period_start IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (d.down_probes * 300)::bigint END AS "Downtime",
  round(d.up_probes::numeric / nullif(d.probes, 0) * 100, 1)::double precision AS "Availability"
FROM days AS day
LEFT JOIN monitoring.db_port_blackbox_daily_kpi d
  ON d.period_start = day.period_start
 AND d.target_name = ${server:sqlstring}
ORDER BY day.period_start DESC;

panels.title: DOWNTIME EVENTS | ${incident_count:text}
panels.description: One row per contiguous DOWN incident. Open-event duration is bounded by the latest failed sample plus five minutes, so missing data does not create unlimited downtime. Partial means the incident began before the oldest raw sample available during initial reconstruction.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN '-infinity'::timestamptz
      ELSE to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')::timestamptz
    END AS from_at,
    CASE
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__range' THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz
      WHEN ${month:sqlstring} = '__all' THEN 'infinity'::timestamptz
      ELSE (to_date(${month:sqlstring} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 month')::timestamptz
    END AS to_at
), latest_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    coalesce(e.down_end, least(now(), e.last_down_at + interval '5 minutes')) AS observed_end
  FROM monitoring.db_port_blackbox_downtime_events e
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE e.target_name = ${server:sqlstring}
    AND e.down_start < b.to_at
    AND coalesce(e.down_end, least(now(), e.last_down_at + interval '5 minutes')) > b.from_at
  ORDER BY e.down_start DESC
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  e.down_start AS "Down Start",
  e.down_end AS "Recovered At",
  e.port AS "Port",
  CASE
    WHEN e.down_end IS NULL THEN 'OPEN'
    WHEN e.source = 'daily-kpi-estimated-00-03' THEN 'ESTIMATED'
    WHEN e.source = 'opmanager-exact-clipped' THEN 'PARTIAL'
    ELSE 'RECOVERED'
  END AS "Status",
  extract(epoch FROM e.observed_end - e.down_start)::bigint AS "Duration",
  e.down_samples AS "Failed Samples",
  CASE
    WHEN e.source = 'opmanager-exact' THEN 'exact'
    WHEN e.source = 'daily-kpi-estimated-00-03' THEN 'estimated'
    WHEN e.source = 'opmanager-exact-clipped' OR e.started_before_retention THEN 'partial'
    ELSE 'observed'
  END AS "Coverage",
  coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.first_error_text), ''), nullif(btrim(e.last_error_text), ''), 'blackbox probe failed') AS "Error Detail"
FROM latest_events e
ORDER BY e.down_start DESC;
